messages:
olivia: Heads-up: promote for release/2.5.3 is blocked  deploy job failing during artifact upload.

ben: Error?

olivia: Yes - artifact service returning 409 on blob commit, logs show 'blob already locked by upload-id 0x9f'. Happens during parallel layer upload.

ci-bot: Postsubmit publish job failed: build/artifacts-publish (exit 1) https://ci.internal/runs/100234 :x:

kai: That's the new multipart uploader change from #4610. Might be a race on reusing upload IDs.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for release/2.5.3 by CI gate (artifact publish failed) :warning:

ben: Options: 1) revert the uploader change 2) add retry/backoff for commit 3) serialize uploads (slower) 4) pin to previous artifact index and re-run.

olivia: Quickest safe path is add commit retry with jitter and short backoff in the publish step. I'll push a tiny fix and re-run.

kai: If retries don't clear it we may need to revert #4610 and cut a patch release later.

olivia: Pushing fix branch now: git checkout -b fix/artifact-commit-retry && git apply commit-retry.patch && git commit -am "retry blob commit on 409 with exponential backoff" && git push origin fix/artifact-commit-retry

ci-bot: Manual rerun link: https://ci.internal/manual/100234?action=rerun

olivia: Rerun started. Fingers crossed. :crossed_fingers:

ci-bot: Rerun result: artifact publish stage still failing intermittently; some runs succeed, some hit the same 409.

ben: Ok if intermittent, can we gate on 2 successful publishes in a row? That feels risky.

kai: Longer term we need upload-id scoping per-run or stronger idempotency. For now we should avoid risking change window.

olivia: Cutoff is in 30m. If we can't get a reliable canary publish before cutoff, we should defer.

deploy-bot: Reminder: I will mark release deferred at cutoff if gate still failing.

ci-bot: New run succeeded on publish step at 1749957020.

ben: Nice. Did it pass all canary checks?

ci-bot: Canary pipeline green.

olivia: Promotion resumed, canary promoted to us-east-1. Leaving thread open until we verify stability across mirrors.

kai: Action items: add an upload-id scoping PR (infra-590), monitor artifact publish errors for 24h, and add a re-run policy doc for transient 409s.

ben: I'll draft release-note blurb about the temporary retry fix and tracking ticket.

olivia: Closing provisional hold; will reopen if errors reappear.
